_about: Open-vocabulary hazard lane (7 Nov). prompt = what YOLOE's text encoder reads; name = what the app uses. Order is the class index and must match HAZARD.names in docs/js/config.js (a test checks). Order follows RNIB 'In My Way' 2025: pavement clutter, e-scooters and bikes, A-boards, overhanging branches, poor pavements, crossings.
